title: LLM-Assisted Content Conditional Debiasing for Fair Text Embedding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text embeddings on stereotype association and representation benchmarks (SEAT, CrowS-Pairs, StereoSet), assessing representation bias in information retrieval using the Bias-IR dataset, and measuring fairness via a novel Content Conditional Equal Distance (CCED) gap metric across LLM-augmented male, female, and neutral text variations.
